description: This file defines a class for validating the CSS 'text-decoration' property values, ensuring they conform to allowed options such as 'underline', 'overline', 'line-through', or 'none'. It performs parsing and validation of input strings against these rules.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_TextDecoration
classes.description: A class for validating CSS 'text-decoration' property values in the HTMLPurifier library.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input string for CSS 'text-decoration' property, allowing only permitted values or 'none'. Returns the validated string or false if invalid.
